From The Hand · Price: the right hand only, by swipe range.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action: your stand swipes a line of space within its reach. Choose one: pull a creature within 20 ft 20 ft toward it (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates; a creature pulled through erased space is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn), or pull yourself 20 ft toward the stand. Once per turn, your stand's Strike can be an erasing swipe: it ignores the target's item bonus to AC.
  • 5: Surge: a swipe Strike deals @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage instead of normal damage and ignores the target's item bonus to AC; a hit erases a chunk of the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1}. On a miss you lose the Stand Point anyway.
  • 9: (20-ft pulls now come at 1st.)
  • 13: The swipe can erase a non-magical object up to 5 ft across, or a projectile aimed at an ally within reach (reaction).
  • 17: On a critical hit with the surge Strike, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 2}.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
